title: Negated remainder modulo a natural number
statement: For natural numbers $a,M$ with $1\le M$, the remainder of $-a$ modulo $M$, computed in the integers, is $0$ when the natural remainder of $a$ modulo $M$ is zero; otherwise it is $M$ minus that remainder.
